notes.title: Balancing Patch 1
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b]  I've been listening to all your feedback and I did some balancing.[/p][p][b]Balancing:[/b] [/p][list][*][p] Lowering the Boss HP in 6 levels[/p][/*][*][p] Lowering corruption damage in 5 levels.[/p][/*][*][p] Lowering prices for 8 key-upgrades[/p][/*][*][p] Increased White Clone movement speed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Now those harder levels should not feel like hitting a wall anymore. [/p][p]Nor levels where perfect runs were needed to beat the boss.[/p]
